create_file_upload: create a file upload record for a user and project with optional SVG security cleanup
create_file_uploads: create multiple file upload records from a dict of uploaded files with size and extension validation
load_tasks: load tasks from request files, url, or json data with validation and format detection
load_tasks_for_async_import: load tasks from a project_import model supporting file uploads, urls, and inline tasks
load_tasks_for_async_import_streaming: load tasks in batches from a project_import model to reduce memory usage during large imports
